recent_excerpts: UK regulator Ofcom launches a formal investigation into Telegram over evidence of child sexual abuse material (CSAM) sharing and potential breaches of the Online Safety Act's encryption reporting rule
Telegram founder Pavel Durov alleges WhatsApp's default end-to-end encryption is misleading, as unencrypted cloud backups can expose billions of user messages.
A new phishing-as-a-service platform called Bluekit provides over 40 templates targeting banks, social media, and email providers, plus an AI assistant for drafting lures.
